item.title: Casa Serena is designed for the ease and comfort of everyday life
item.description: Casa Serena by Chambray & Co. embodies the Italian concept of 'dolce far niente,' offering a collection designed for everyday comfort and elegance. With a focus on timeless silhouettes and material integrity, the collection emphasizes handloom fabrics and refined detailing. The pieces, like the Saanvi co-ord set and Lorena ensemble, balance craft and practicality, reflecting a woman's heritage and individuality.

item.title: This edit is a celebration of movement and memory inspired by the Northern Lights
item.description: Pocket Stories' AW25 collection, inspired by the Northern Lights, redefines partywear as an experience rather than mere decoration. The collection features garments that transform and hold memories, much like the aurora itself. With a focus on enclothed cognition, the designs include draped gowns, structured jumpsuits, and adaptable pieces that encourage movement and confidence, all while maintaining the brand's signature craftsmanship.
